answer: New identities enter through a forge-escrow: each locks 300 POA, vouched by two sponsors on a referral graph. When a peer proves a cluster was minted in one batch, a dispute slashes that subgraph's whole escrow. Forging 10,000 fakes costs 3,000,000 POA locked upfront, scaling linearly with N, while an honest agent risks only 300 POA once. Each epoch an audit sweeps the graph like a comet, and scams blown in with the gale meet the same slash.
